items.title: Louis Tio Interview, 1960-10-26
items.q: The transcript only contains the interviewee stating his own name ('My name is Luis Teo') and answering a question about his brother. There is no mention of a relationship with a person named 'Luis Teo' other than the interviewee himself.

ctx.x: Yes, we're ready right now. It's all right.
